dogecoin.text:
The blockchain protocols that are most destructive (Bitcoin, Ethereum, Dogecoin) get the most institutional and cultural support.

The same is true for the NFT marketplaces that are the dirtiest (OpenSea, Rarible, Foundation).

Something tells me this is a feature, not a bug...

Bitcoin is the coal of cryptocurrency — terrible for the environment, and only useful for one thing.

Ethereum is the oil — many more practical uses, but still horrible for the planet.

Dogecoin is the natural gas — seems safe and friendly on the surface, but still polluting.
@kidjim25 @loononastring Dogecoin is proof of work too. Same exact issues.
